purpose: Isolate the contribution of each soft-stage loss under a matched protocol.

interpretation.Lout: Supported if removal increases exterior leakage without a compensating projection-quality gain.
interpretation.Lssim: Supported if removal degrades mean IoU or Dice across the fixed task-seed cohort.
interpretation.Ldice: Report the measured effect; do not claim a contribution if confidence intervals overlap or removal improves the metrics.

exclusions: No task selection after observing ablation outcomes.
No joint-versus-sequential update comparison in this loss-component table.
No geometry, connectivity, material, or mesh metrics.
